_comment: Hand curation that must survive an automated roster rebuild.
Keyed by BIOGUIDE ID, which is stable for a person's whole career — unlike names,
which vary between sources ('Bernie Sanders' vs 'Bernard Sanders') and would silently
create a duplicate person if used as the join key.
name  — preferred display name, when the official_full form reads worse.
These MUST match roster_map.json keys exactly: the finance join is by name.
title — leadership role, appended after the party/state in the role string.
term  — overrides the term key derived from Senate class / House cycle.
Only needed for people leaving early; classes derive correctly on their own.
Everything not listed here is generated from congress-legislators.

_removed.David Scott: Listed on the page as a sitting Representative (D-GA), but no longer appears in congress-legislators' current roster and holds no seat in the 119th Congress. Removed 2026-08-18 during the roster expansion.
